body.p: Long ago. Long ago, the Evenks were very bad. They ate everything(?). The Evenks were greedy.[DCh]: "NÊ¼urÉ£a" could also be a Moss, mouses, worms, they ate everything. Once an old man thought. He had set on variant of "nÊ¼urgÉ" 'thin; skinny'. a lot of branches in the river, there is not a single fish. Again the old man thought. He made(?) nets out of willow bark(?). Then he set on these nets in the river, there is not a single fish. Again the old man thought. Then he made a seine out of roots. The old man fished with the seine on the lake. There he caught one fish. Again he set on the seine, again he caught a fish. Like that the Evenks caught fish in the olden times. There are such stories.
